news.headline: Crude firms: WTI +0.6%, Brent +0.9%
news.what_happened: WTI at $86.58 and Brent at $92.32, both higher overnight.
news.why_it_matters: Higher realisations support upstream producers; raises cost pressure for airlines, paints and tyres.

news.headline: US 10Y yield jumps to ~4.98%; Wall Street slips
news.what_happened: S&P 500 -0.38%, Nasdaq -0.74%, US 10Y up about 12 bps to 4.98%.
news.why_it_matters: Risk-off tone and higher yields can weigh on FII flows, IT and rate-sensitive sectors.

news.headline: Asia mixed: Hang Seng -0.65%, Nikkei +0.72%
news.what_happened: Hang Seng fell to 24,397 while Nikkei gained to 60,894. Nifty closed at 25,045 (+0.06%).
news.why_it_matters: No clear regional cue; Indian market likely to open flat to slightly weak.
